notes: §1985:XIII.4.3.4 GR6: on a GENERATE after the first, sense a control break (equality by relation-condition rules), give the control footing USE procedures and SOURCE clauses the prior values (a.1), 'Process the control footing report groups in the order minor to major', then the control headings major to minor, then the detail or (GENERATE report-name) the summary steps. ReportWriter#GenerateCore does it: DetectBreakLevel compares each control with its prior, SaveCurrentRestorePriors puts the priors in place for ProcessControlFootings, the current values are restored before the CHs, and WithPageGroupControlValues gives a page group reached by a footing's page advance the current values at 85 (§1985:XIII.3.20.4 GR13 c, DialectBehavior.ControlFootingPageGroupsSeePriorControlValues from 2002). Probes at 85: a CF USE and CF SOURCE show the prior MIN/MAJ while a non-control item shows its current value, -1 to -1.0 is no break, a major break prints CF-MIN then CF-MAJ, GENERATE report-name with CONTROLS FINAL and a group control prints CH/CF and SUMs but no detail, a page advance after the footings prints PF/PH; a PH/PF SOURCE or USE referencing a control item is refused at 85 (COBOL6825), accepted at 2023. The witness prints the CH/DE/CF order of two minor breaks and one major break. History: until the 1985 re-read 5 (2026-11-14) this row read PARTIAL, naming kb/Work PB5128 (landed), kb/Work PB5337 (landed); the re-read of main dc1f2dcce8 found that defect fixed by the landing of kb/Work PB5128 and records CONFORMS, upheld by an independent refuter (code read: op-20261114/out-reread5/rs-10.json, refuter op-20261114/out-reread5/rs-10-refute.json).

next.reason: Order kept: sense the break, control footings minor up and headings major down to the break level, then detail or summary (§2023:14.9.16.4 GR5 'each control footing and control heading is printed, if defined, up to the level of the control break'; §2023:14.9.16.4 GR2; §2023:14.9.16.4 GR3; §2023:13.18.16.4 GR3 equality test). Changed: 1985 a.1 gives the prior control values only to 'the control footing USE procedures and control footing SOURCE clauses', and 1985 XIII.3.20.4 GR13c gives every other report-group reference the current values. 2023 §2023:13.18.16.4 GR4 a): 'If the printing of the control footing causes a page advance and the page heading or page footing refers to a control data item, the value produced is similarly the prior value.' A 1985 page footing SOURCE naming a control item prints a different value when a control footing forces the page advance.
